reason: Tuesday is dead and this is aimed straight at it — a league table is a reason for the same faces to come back next Tuesday, and a screen that settles a frame saves me arguing in the group at midnight. The first month is free and there is no contract, so trying it costs me nothing but my own time.
objection: Fifteen hundred a month for four nights still nags at me, and my regulars live in that WhatsApp group — I am not sure they will bother scanning a code when they can just type in the group like always.
